environment.concept: Rainy Japanese neighbourhood cafe: sage plaster walls, walnut wainscot and cap rails, dark wood-framed rain-streaked window on the north wall, quiet terracotta herringbone floor, warm amber light, chrome espresso machine in the rear right, porcelain cup on a small walnut pedestal at the left.

sprites.label: Rain-streaked cafe window
sprites.query: Steady natural rainfall pattering against the glass of a large closed cafe window, delicate individual droplets and soft water texture, clean physical recording, no people

sprites.label: Chrome espresso machine
sprites.query: A cafe espresso machine steam wand releasing a continuous airy steam hiss with subtle boiler texture, authentic coffee equipment recording, no voices

sprites.label: Porcelain cup and saucer
sprites.query: One porcelain espresso cup gently set onto its ceramic saucer, a clear delicate clink with natural short decay, isolated single occurrence
